issues: The fanfare cost-reduction ability is too broad; `grantNextPlayCostReduction.filter` should restrict to cards that are either Festive and cost 3 or less or Mage and cost 3 or less, not all cards costing 3 or less.

The triggered damage ability is too broad and has the wrong duration/timing placement; it should only trigger when you play a Festive card that costs 3 or less or a Mage card that costs 3 or less, and it should be represented as a continuous/field trigger rather than granted only by fanfare for this turn.

The fanfare effect is encoded as a single-choice `choose` between 2 Ghost or 2 Forest Bat, but the text says to put 2 Ghost or Forest Bat tokens into your EX area, allowing any mix totaling 2. This should be encoded as an effect that creates 2 tokens with per-token choice of Ghost or Forest Bat. Implement a new ability op for mixed token choice summoning, such as `summonChoiceTokens` with selectable token identities and total count.
The fanfare incorrectly makes the discard unconditional; the discard should happen only if you put a follower into your EX area this way.
